title: Pullback naturality of the Kummer Chern morphism in coefficient towers
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, and let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Put $B_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ and $A_T=((B_n)_T)_{n\geq1}$, with quotient transitions, on the small pro-etale site of $T=X,Y$. Use the varying-coefficient tower categories [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] and their ordinary derived categories, and the exact tower inverse-image functor $f_\bullet^*$ [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Let $c_1(L):A_Y\to A_Y(1)[2]$ and $c_1(f^*L):A_X\to A_X(1)[2]$ be the coefficient-linear Kummer Chern morphisms constructed in [det-sp-tower-classes](2), using the same connecting-morphism sign convention. Let $\theta_f^0:f_\bullet^*A_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X$ be the coefficient-unit identification. Let $\theta_f^1:f_\bullet^*A_Y(1)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X(1)$ be induced by the roots-of-unity pullback maps and the coefficient-unit maps of [det-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients-twists], with transitions $z\otimes a\mapsto z^\ell\otimes\bar a$. Then, with the canonical shift comparison understood,
$$\theta_f^1[2]\circ f_\bullet^*(c_1(L))=c_1(f^*L)\circ\theta_f^0$$
in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(X,\mathcal O_E))$. This is equality of the actual tower-derived morphisms, without a Noetherian, finite-type or flatness hypothesis on $f$.
